summary_1line: Night battle escalates: Bhima devastates Kaurava princes; Somadatta challenges Satyaki; Drona ravages Pandava troops; Ghatotkacha and Aswatthaman clash amid terrifying Rakshasa illusions.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima leaps onto a Kalinga prince’s chariot and kills him with crushing bare fists, bones scattering across the battlefield.
The gigantic Rakshasa Ghatotkacha rides a monstrous eight‑wheeled iron chariot draped with skins and entrails, surrounded by roaring Rakshasas under the night sky.
Ghatotkacha hurls a blazing thousand‑spoked wheel at Aswatthaman, who shatters it midair with arrows that spark across the dark sky.
